{"relevant":true,"layer":"company","reason":"This collective labour agreement (PKB) sets company payroll rules that affect PPh 21 for permanent employees. It provides a tax allowance (gross-up) equal to the income tax due, with the company bearing the tax on bonuses. It fixes multiples of basic pay for THR, the 13th wage, leave allowances and long-leave compensation. It sets employer-paid JKK and JKM contributions as a percentage of basic pay, which enter gross income. It sets DPLK pension contributions for both employer and employee, which affect gross income and deductions.
